passages.note: Lists Bolick as a co-sponsor of SB 1164 (2022), a single-subject gestational-limit abortion bill.

passages.provision_quote: Except in a medical emergency, a physician may not intentionally or knowingly perform, induce or attempt to perform or induce an abortion if the probable gestational age of the unborn human being has been determined to be greater than fifteen weeks.
passages.note: Prints the operative gestational-limit clause and medical-emergency exception enacted by SB 1164.
Records Bolick's Yea vote on the House Third Reading final passage of SB 1164.

rows.reasoning: As a State Representative, Bolick co-sponsored SB 1164 (2022) and cast a Yea vote on its House Third Reading final passage; the single-subject bill's operative clause bars abortion after fifteen weeks' gestation except in a medical emergency, matching the rung that allows abortion in early pregnancy and after that only to protect the mother's health. Her House-term record counts for her current Senate seat under the same-legislature rule.
